originals.why: Natural relative clause after faint o bobl; pobl means people, as this course teaches it.

originals.ko: 나는 얼마나 많은 사람들이 ~인지 확실하지 않아
originals.why: Natural open fragment; ~ marks the open end.
Idiomatic aros am; y bobl ’na means those people.

originals.ko: 너는 너무 많이 말하는 사람들을 좋아해?
originals.why: Natural North Welsh; pobl means people.

originals.ko: 나는 너무 많이 말하는 사람들을 만나고 싶지 않아
너는 왜 너무 많이 말하는 사람들을 만나고 싶어?
나는 멈추고 싶지 않아, 왜냐하면 오늘 다른 사람들이 여기 있으니까
originals.why: Natural; 오늘 goes after 왜냐하면 so heddiw can only sit in the achos clause.

originals.ko: 그는 네가 말한 것을 아무에게도 듣게 하고 싶어하지 않아, 왜냐하면 다른 사람들이 여기 있으니까
originals.why: Natural and grammatical; pobl means people.
Same verb form; using it in a question is its most common use and is natural North Welsh. A sense extension from the emphatic copula, but not a wrong one.
Natural question with ydyn nhw; barod soft-mutated correctly after ’n.
Natural; diddorol after ’n is correct (d does not mutate after yn predicative).

originals.ko: 그들은 오늘 우리가 끝내는 걸 확실히 하고 싶어해?
originals.why: Natural North Welsh question; bo’ ni’n clause is idiomatic.
